description: Prompted and Unprompted Awareness of Road Safety Advertising is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Motor Accident Commission. 2011-2015 Market Research data surveying South Australians 16 years and over with regard to their awareness of Road Safety Advertising across a broad ranges of topics. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Motor Accident Commission. Its tags are MAC, accident, advertising, awareness, commission. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
